name: robots/qdeyna__ur10e_2f140_topic_based_ros2_control
title: UR10e arm (fake hardware)
intro: UR10e arm (fake hardware), adapted from qdeyna/ur10e_2f140_topic_based_ros2_control. It reads `joint_positions`, `joint_velocities` and `read_joint_state`; runs `follow_arm_trajectory` and `activate_trajectory_controller`. `follow_arm_trajectory`: send FollowJointTrajectory points on the fake-hardware scaled controller; return the controller error_code and error_string. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
